title: 21bis Boulevard Diderot
description: A Haussmann-era corner apartment block opposite Gare de Lyon: a south-facing stone facade with continuous wrought-iron balconies, a brasserie at street level and a zinc mansard roof.

notes: Position and heading: Commons {{Location}} geotag with compass heading (phone GPS + compass; accuracy unknown).
hfov 71.6° from EXIF 35 mm-equivalent focal length 24 mm on a 4:3 landscape frame (diagonal convention).
Pitch 22° estimated by eye: pedestrians' heads (≈ 1.6 m eye level) sit at ≈ 88% of the image height; strong vertical convergence confirms an upward shot.
hfovRange = [0.5, 1.05] × the EXIF-derived hfov: a crop can only narrow the field of view and nothing widens it, so auto-alignment keeps the FOV inside these bounds.
